title: SLO Mosaic: initiative tagging, burn attribution, and handoff timeline
creator: Riley Carter
description: Problem: Teams struggle to track SLO initiative ownership across cycles: error-budget attribution is ambiguous, runways are not visible to downstream teams, and handoffs to oncall/ops lack clear acceptance criteria. This ticket defines the 'SLO Mosaic' pattern: a standardized initiative card schema, burn attribution model, and a handoff timeline that integrates with our Initiative Hub and Release Calendar.
context_and_goals: Reduce cross-team ambiguity about who is driving SLO remediation and experiments
Create a machine-readable initiative card schema so dashboards can aggregate burn by tag and owner
Document a 3-step handoff timeline so canary/remediation steps map to error-budget tranches
Surface runway warnings earlier via visual thresholds tied to SLI forecasts
acceptance_criteria: A JSON schema for initiative cards exists and is published in Confluence with examples
Initiative Hub accepts and displays at least three new fields: primary_burn_tag, remediation_owner, handoff_deadline
Dashboard can show per-initiative error-budget burn (7d, 30d) and attribute to tagged initiatives
Handoff checklist created and used in two pilot teams during Cycle 11 with sign-offs recorded
Documentation includes migration notes for existing initiatives and a rollback strategy

decisions_and_tradeoffs: Attribution model: use tag-based proportional allocation (weights by request count) to avoid expensive trace-level joins — chosen for performance but accepts some noise.
Visibility model: surfaced summary-level burn by default; detailed event-level view behind a permissions flag to limit exposure of sensitive metrics.
Handoff deadline enforcement: soft reminders (email/Slack) rather than hard blockers to avoid blocking fast-moving experiments; will reassess if pilots show missed handoffs.
pilot_plan: Week 1 (2025-03-10 to 2025-03-16): Enable tags on active SLO initiatives for platform and payments teams
Week 2: Monitor burn attribution and collect feedback via 15-minute syncs
Week 3: Run handoff walkthroughs and collect sign-offs; iterate on checklist
Week 4: Decide production rollout or additional pilot expansion
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Attribution noise causing wrong owner escalation. Mitigation: include 'confidence' score and a manual override on initiative cards.
Risk: Telemetry cost increase from additional queries. Mitigation: cache 7d/30d aggregates and compute attribution in batch jobs.
Risk: Teams ignore the handoff checklist. Mitigation: require sign-off during sprint review for pilot teams and feed into release readiness checklist.
